title: Node_Select mirror's terminal→clear branch is implemented correctly but pinned by no scenario
detail: A mutation that SELECTS terminals on a terminal cursor leaves every assert green: scenario 23's final sel_node==-1 comes from the demolish, not the mirror; scenarios 17/18 assert pad_node only. The story-card 'terminal → clear' (E2 mirror) leg is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Park the pad cursor on a terminal (e.g. extend input_parity_pad_cursor_up or scenario 23 with an intermediate assert) and assert sel_node == -1, pinning the mirror's else branch.

title: The 'swallowed — no re-select' release frames in scenarios 23/24 are vacuous — a dropped swallow latch would not fail the suite
evidence:
harness/parity.odin:759-760: `evs(inp.Mouse_Press{pos = btn_node, button = .Left}), // the demolish button
			evs(inp.Mouse_Release{pos = btn_node, button = .Left}), // swallowed — no re-select` — harness/parity.odin:793-794: `evs(inp.Mouse_Press{pos = btn_pipe, button = .Left}), // the pipe demolish button
			evs(inp.Mouse_Release{pos = btn_pipe, button = .Left}), // swallowed — no re-select` — harness/parity.odin:1096-1097: `if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Mouse); ok && r.sel_node != -1 {
			append(fails, fmt.tprintf("  %s mouse: the button demolish must clear the selection (sel_node %d, want -1)", sc.name, r.sel_node))`
detail: After the demolish fires, a re-select at the button center hits no live node (nearest alive ~12 tiles away) and no live pipe (the demolished one is dead), so a dropped press-swallow latch leaves the same final selection and the suite stays green.
recommended_fix: Make a release frame's point land on a selectable entity (or add a follow-up release on a live node) so a dropped swallow latch changes the final selection and trips the assert.
